drive.description: Road-wheel roll angle (axle side-gear angle) about +X; positive drives forward

diff_front.description: Front differential split: left side gear +, right side gear - (half difference)

diff_rear.description: Rear differential split: left side gear +, right side gear - (half difference)

diff_center.description: Centre differential split: front axle +, rear axle - (half difference)

gear_select.description: Rotary catch angle of the sequential 4-speed; 0, pi/2, pi, 3pi/2 select gears 1-4 (cyclic). The cab dial turns the other way

range_select.description: Range lever: -1 low, +1 high (driving ring 0/0/128/62 travel)

direction_select.description: Direction lever: +1 forward through the 4-speed, -1 reverse (driving ring 0/0/128/61 travel)

phase_engine.description: Carry offset of the engine-side gear train (engine, camshaft, 4-speed input); keyed at ratio changes so angles stay continuous

phase_mid.description: Carry offset of the 4-speed output, rear propshaft and range gears; keyed at ratio changes so angles stay continuous

phase_c26.description: Carry offset of the range output shaft 0/0/128/58; keyed at ratio changes so angles stay continuous

winch.description: Winch knob angle (12T knob 0/69 about its vertical axle)

steering.description: Steering wheel angle about the column; positive is clockwise for the driver

notes: Source 42110-1.mpd (Philippe Hurbain) is unmodified; occurrence IDs are its type-1 index paths.
Frame: LDU, -Y up, front -Z, car's left +X; longitudinal shafts use the measured 0.003 rad chassis tilt.

Contacts: bounded pyldraw3 run over 1538 non-embedded, non-cosmetic parts (226/230 axles with axle-hole contacts); axle-locked groups define rigid shafts. Embedded pre-release DATs use their library alias frames for analysis only.
Every gear mesh, clutch lock and differential relation is checked in all 16 gear/range/direction states by scripts/build_defender_rig.py (mesh residual < 1e-12 rad).

Driving-ring travel (10 LDU) is taken from the source 1st-gear ring offset. The rotary catch cam profile is assumed: each ring follows 10*sat(cos/sin of the catch angle) with an 18 degree dwell, so rings never overlap.
Shifts change ratios: the animation keys phase_engine / phase_mid / phase_c26 at each ratio change so every shaft stays continuous.
Propshafts A and B: intermediate forks measured in phase within 0.01 degree and snapped exactly in phase (constant velocity).
Not modelled: suspension travel, body hinges, rope/hose, winch ratchet, friction, backlash, gravity. Clearance is sampled, not proven.

steering.label: Steering wheel and roof knob to the front knuckles
notes: Rack -15.279 LDU per pinion radian (12T, rack_ratio)
Steering wheel range +/-2.583 rad for +/-18.0 LDU rack travel
steering.review: Two exact cardan joints, three measured gear meshes, rack-and-pinion and two closed 100 LDU ball links; the roof knob is geared to the same input shaft through the diagonal 24T/20T mesh.

front_axle.label: Front differential, half shafts and wheels
notes: l half shaft bend 12.0 deg; exact cardan at the diff, CV at the hub
r half shaft bend 12.0 deg; exact cardan at the diff, CV at the hub
front_axle.review: 28T ring / 20T pinion and 12T spider bevels measured; cardan joint at the diff and CV spindle at each hub; front wheels ride the steering knuckles.

rear_axle.label: Rear differential, half shafts and wheels
notes: l half shaft bend 12.0 deg; exact cardan at the diff, CV at the hub
r half shaft bend 12.0 deg; exact cardan at the diff, CV at the hub
rear_axle.review: Same layout as the front axle; rear knuckles are fixed.

centre_diff.label: Propshafts, centre differential and transfer shaft
centre_diff.review: 8T/24T steps to both axles; centre carrier drives the transfer shaft by its 16T ring.

gearbox.label: Range and direction gearbox (middle box) with its cab levers
notes: 0/0/128/76/19: fork arm 40.00 LDU below the X pivot
0/0/128/76/10: fork arm 40.00 LDU below the X pivot
gearbox.review: Ring 0/0/128/61 picks forward (clutch 66, through the 4-speed) or reverse (clutch 50, direct); ring 0/0/128/62 picks low (20T clutch 48 via extension 57) or high (clutch 63). Catches are measured 40 LDU forks.

sequential.label: Sequential 4-speed (rear box), rotary catch, dial and internal propshafts
notes: Propshaft pa: measured intermediate fork phase 0.0117 deg, snapped in phase
Propshaft pb: measured intermediate fork phase 0.0191 deg, snapped in phase
Propshaft A: two cardan joints at 32.2 deg, forks in phase
Propshaft B: two cardan joints at 41.8 deg, forks in phase
sequential.review: Constant-mesh trains at z=360 and z=280; two driving rings select 1st-4th alternately (ratios checked); two in-phase double cardan propshafts link it to the middle box.

engine.label: Inline six: camshaft and six cam-driven pistons
notes: piston1 0/0/126/7: cam 0/0/127/2 at +180 deg, rest lift 0.0
piston2 0/0/126/10: cam 0/0/127/3 at -90 deg, rest lift 0.0
piston3 0/0/126/13: cam 0/0/127/5 at +0 deg, rest lift 0.0
piston4 0/0/126/16: cam 0/0/127/4 at -90 deg, rest lift 0.0
piston5 0/0/126/19: cam 0/0/127/6 at +90 deg, rest lift 10.0
piston6 0/0/126/22: cam 0/0/127/7 at -0 deg, rest lift 0.0
engine.review: Camshaft geared 1:1 to the gearbox input through idler 0/0/128/35; piston lift max(0,20 sin(a-theta)-10).

winch.label: Winch knob, bevels and drum
winch.review: Three 12T bevel meshes measured (knob 0/69 under the bonnet). The rope is static.

flexible.label: Rope, hose, bands and hook
flexible.review: Flexible LDCad paths (rope merged into one mesh) and the winch hook stay static; unwinding is not modelled.

suspension.label: Independent double-wishbone suspension (all corners)
suspension.review: Static ride height by decision: each shock absorber is one rigid part, and travel needs a per-wheel loop solve with the steering links and half shafts.

body_openings.label: Doors, bonnet, tailgate, roof trunk, side case and ladder
body_openings.review: Bodywork is hidden by request, so its hinges are not rigged.

bodywork.label: Other hidden bodywork axles and pins
bodywork.review: Structural axles and pins inside hidden body sections; hidden by request, not reviewed.

winch_ratchet.label: Winch ratchet pawl
winch_ratchet.review: Pawl bearing on the 16T ratchet gear 0/111; clicking is a surface contact and is not animated.

brackets.label: Camshaft, selector-dial and gearbox brackets
brackets.review: Reviewed in renders and contacts: pinned to the engine block or frame (0/0/127/14 to 0/0/126/2), carry round bearing holes only.

supports.label: Frame axles, pins and connectors
supports.review: Axle/pin/connector supports of the chassis and gearbox frames, not traced to any motion path; not individually reviewed.
